programme.title: Mashup o emocích! Ďurica a psycholožka
programme.desc: Michaelův Mashup | Adam Ďurica & Iva Poláčková Šolcová | Proč nás emoce řídí víc, než si myslíme? Proč nás emoce ovládají mnohem víc, než si připouštíme? Jak ovládat emoce? Proč je důležité se nudit? A proč právě nuda pomohla Adamu Ďuricovi napsat jeho první hity? Speciální vydání Michaelova Mashupu z Colours of Ostrava – Meltingpotu, natočené ve spolupráci s Akademií věd ČR, propojuje svět hudby a psychologie. Hosty jsou slovenský zpěvák Adam Ďurica a sociální psycholožka Iva Poláčková Šolcová, která se dlouhodobě věnuje emocím, psychické odolnosti a lidskému chování. V rozhovoru se dozvíte: • proč nás emoce řídí víc, než si myslíme • jakých je pět základních kroků ke zvládání emocí • proč bychom se měli učit emoční gramotnost celý život • jak využít nudu jako zdroj kreativity • proč Adam Ďurica tvrdí, že bez nudy by nevznikla píseň Mandolína • jak hudba vyvolává emoce • proč se podle psychologie téměř nedá hádat vleže • jak pracovat s emocemi ve vztazích i v běžném životě ? Natočeno 15. července 2026 na festivalu Colours of Ostrava – Meltingpot ve spolupráci s Akademií věd ČR

programme.title: Mashup o emocích! Ďurica a psycholožka
programme.desc: Michaelův Mashup | Adam Ďurica & Iva Poláčková Šolcová | Proč nás emoce řídí víc, než si myslíme? Proč nás emoce ovládají mnohem víc, než si připouštíme? Jak ovládat emoce? Proč je důležité se nudit? A proč právě nuda pomohla Adamu Ďuricovi napsat jeho první hity? Speciální vydání Michaelova Mashupu z Colours of Ostrava – Meltingpotu, natočené ve spolupráci s Akademií věd ČR, propojuje svět hudby a psychologie. Hosty jsou slovenský zpěvák Adam Ďurica a sociální psycholožka Iva Poláčková Šolcová, která se dlouhodobě věnuje emocím, psychické odolnosti a lidskému chování. V rozhovoru se dozvíte: • proč nás emoce řídí víc, než si myslíme • jakých je pět základních kroků ke zvládání emocí • proč bychom se měli učit emoční gramotnost celý život • jak využít nudu jako zdroj kreativity • proč Adam Ďurica tvrdí, že bez nudy by nevznikla píseň Mandolína • jak hudba vyvolává emoce • proč se podle psychologie téměř nedá hádat vleže • jak pracovat s emocemi ve vztazích i v běžném životě ? Natočeno 15. července 2026 na festivalu Colours of Ostrava – Meltingpot ve spolupráci s Akademií věd ČR

programme.title: Rodinné prípady (2)
programme.desc: Život po smrti Skutočné príbehy ľudí, ktorým sa život vymkol z rúk.

programme.title: Smrtící hora
programme.desc: K záchraně horolezce chyběl jen kousek, teď jsou v ohrožení všichni. Aby zachránili svět před ničivou zbraní teroristů, musí zdolat nejnebezpečnější horu světa. Skupina horolezců pod vedením zkušeného Johna Deckerta zachraňuje horolezce, který uvízl na strmé stěně vysoké hory v Rocky Mountains. Jedno jištění povolí a Nikki, snoubenka Johnova kamaráda Solomona Daviese, se propadne o několik metrů. Nic by se nestalo, kdyby v úleku nevykřikla.

programme.title: Ghoul
programme.desc: Trojice filmařů se vydává na Ukrajinu s cílem natočit unikátní dokument o kanibalismu. Strašlivý hladomor v letech 1932-1933 tu dohnal spoustu lidí k děsivým činům. Nečekaně se jejich pátrání začíná propojovat s příběhem jednoho z nejzvrácenějších zločinců novodobé historie, kanibala Andreje Čikatila. Během 12 let spáchal přes padesát brutálních vražd, při nichž své oběti částečně snědl. Společně s místní tlumočnicí, průvodcem a senzibilkou se snaží odhalit tajemství domu, kde se vše odehrávalo.

programme.title: MayDay
programme.desc: Komerční pilot Brodie Torrance, bývalý pilot RAF ze Skotska, letí se 14 cestujícími a třemi členy posádky ze Singapuru do Honolulu přes Tokio. Mezi cestujícími je uprchlík podezřelý z vraždy Louis Gaspare, kterého na cestě do Kanady doprovází důstojník kanadské jízdní policie. Na pokyn jednoho ze svých nadřízených se Brodie vydá zkratkou přes Jihočínské moře, ale dostanou se do strašlivé bouře. Úder blesku odpálí avioniku letadla a letuška i důstojník jsou během turbulencí zabiti.

programme.title: Cesta za pokladem
programme.desc: Cesta za pokladem nebo mýty a legendy ze světa peněz je šestidílný veselý příběh pro děti o sourozencích Maxovi a Mili, kteří se vydají na cestu za pokladem, aby mohli koupit narozeninový dárek své mamince. Maxovi a Mili na jejich cestě pomáhá babi Majka a její pejsek Money. V každé epizodě se děti naučí něco zajímavého ze světa peněz a navíc zjistí, co vše může být vzácné jako poklad. Slovenský naučně-zábavný seriál

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Sníček (7)
programme.desc: Hugo splní dětem každý sen! V noci snové víly přinášejí dětem sny. Ale co dělají přes den? Hugo se nudí, a tak si usmyslí, že Lucii a Damiána bude navštěvovat i během dne. Jelikož se však neumí v našem světě chovat, děti ho musí učit základy slušné výchovy. On jim za to vysvětlí, jak fungují nejznámější hodiny na světě Big Ben, a ukáže, jak žijí různá zvířata. Vezme je do džungle, pod mořskou hladinu, do vesmíru, a také do svého snového světa, kde je možné opravdu všechno.

programme.title: Zabij nudu!
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (22)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: O modrém autíčku (12)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál o dobrodružstvích modrého autíčka a jeho kamarádů. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (12)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: O Dorotce (2)
programme.desc: Holčička Dorotka a její věrný kamarád papoušek Koko spolu prožívají různá veselá dobrodružství. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (11)
programme.desc: Další dobrodružství Macha a Šebestové. Po cestě ze školy viděli, jak se koupou děti a rozhodli se, že vezmou s sebou i psa Jonatána. Šli tedy za paní Kadrnožkovou, jestli jim psa půjčí. Jenže se dozvěděli, že paní Kadrnožková psa prodala. Řekla jim komu a oni se tedy vydali za majitelem. Jenže tam viděli, že majitelé psa Jonatána využívají jako svého otroka. Nosil jim jídlo, myl auto. Mach vytáhl sluchátko a Jonatána proměnil ve vrabce, jenže jenom na chvíli, protože ho málem snědla kočka.

programme.title: Krakonošovy pohádky (8)
programme.desc: Před mnoha a mnoha lety, kdy lesy byly plné zvěře a ptactva, vládl horám u pramenů Labe Krakonoš. Na jeho kraj bylo utěšené podívání, ale o živobytí se v něm musel každý s přírodou poprat... Východoněmecko-československý animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Příběhy kocoura Modroočka (2)
programme.desc: Modroočko má jemný kožíšek, velikánské modré oči, dlouhé vlasy a hebký čumáček. Je to vzdělaný kocourek, který si píše deník a bydlí u svého pána, spisovatele. Objevuje svět kolem sebe a vypráví o všech svých dvounohých a čtyřnohých přátelích. Z díry v plotu ho zachrání nový přítel - kocour Bělovous, na dovolené získá další přátele - ježka Šramotu, loveckého psa Fouska a králíka Bílé Pírko. Také se seznámí s kočičkou Kiki a popere se kvůli ní s obrovským zlomyslným kocourem Žluťákem.

programme.title: Broučci (3)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Brundibáři (6)
programme.desc: Kratičké příběhy dvou čmeláků, kteří se stejně jmenují a navlas se sobě i podobají. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Tisíc a jedna noc (4)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál, jehož jednotlivé části vyprávějí příhody ze známé knihy Pohádky tisíce a jedné noci. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Dva lidi v ZOO
programme.desc: O dvou hříšnících v ráji divokých zvířat. Hlavní postavou je starý zoolog Montelík, přezdívaný Monty. Seznámit se s ním můžete v okamžiku, kdy se od něj odstěhuje jeho žena Josefína, protože už má dost problémů, které jim působí zvířata ze zdejší ZOO, a kdy k nim mají přijet na návštěvu vnuci Martin a Honza, k nerozeznání si podobná dvojčata. K problémům s dvojčaty, která se rozhodnou před dospělými vydávat za jednoho, však přibudou další.

programme.title: Černá sobota
programme.desc: Zloději ukradnou ze železničního vagónu metylalkohol. Sami na to doplatí životem, ale v ohrožení jsou i další konzumenti. Neznámí zloději odčerpali z cisterny alkohol, aniž by tušili, že se jedná o smrtelně jedovatý metylalkohol, určený pro průmyslové účely. Zjišťování, kam všude byl jed dopraven a které lidi ohrožuje, vyžaduje mravenčí práci kriminalistů. Československé krimi drama

programme.title: Filmové písničky Hugo Haase
programme.desc: Hudební pořad postavený na písničkách českého herce Hugo Haase. Pořadem provází populární imitátor Petr Martinák. Český hudební program . Účinkují: Petr Martinák, Hugo Haas

programme.title: Waterloo
programme.desc: Ve vypjaté dramatické situaci jedné červnové noci roku 1815 několik hodin před bitvou, která se zdá předem prohraná, má Napoleon na vybranou: buď jít do bitvy a riskovat, že ji nevyhraje, nebo do bitvy nejít, což ovšem znamená abdikovat. Vzdát se absolutní moci a své vojenské zkušenosti nabídnout lidu, republice... Československé historické drama

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Kde řeky mají slunce
programme.desc: a kde má každý lidskou tvář. Snímek Václava Kršky vznikl na motivy první části románu Marie Majerové Nejkrásnější svět. Lenka Bilanská opouští na začátku I. světové války svůj rodný mlýn. Nedokáže už snášet dusnou a tíživou atmosféru domova, kde despoticky vládne surový a lakomý otec, a vydá se hledat ten vysněný budoucí „nejkrásnější svět“. Evropa vchází do první světové války a na venkovském mlýně panuje despotická atmosféra, kterou citlivá dívka již nedokáže dál snášet.

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Poslední zastávka smrt
programme.desc: Poblíž lékárny je nalezen zavražděný muž... Veronika Jeníková v kriminálním filmu z prostředí, kde vládnou drogy. Hlavní roli v kriminálním příběhu na motivy novely J. Cimického hraje mladá narkomanka Jarmila Křížová a její parťák, řečený Faraon - Zobák. Pod Jarmiliným vedením organizuje partu mladistvých, kteří vykrádají lékárny a jiné obchody. Zobák při jedné „akci" dokonce zavraždí staršího muže, jehož tělo objevil Ivan. Křížová se s Ivanem záměrně seznámí, aby zjistila, co ví.

programme.title: Návrat
programme.desc: Záhadný telefonát, který zastihne písničkářku Sáru na klubovém vystoupení, ji přiměje vyhledat ještě před půlnocí osamělou hospůdku ve vesničce za Prahou. Čeká tam na ni bývalý přítel, který ji kdysi zradil a opustil, ale také nostalgie, vzpomínky a ztracené sny. Podivná noc, podivní hospodští hosté a šokující ranní probuzení. Nic už nebude jako dřív! Český krátkometrážní psychologický horor

programme.title: Žofka a její dobrodružství (5)
programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: Smích se lepí na paty
programme.desc: Smutná komedie o mládí pošetilého starce. Příběh o vesnickém všeumělovi Joskovi Platejzovi, který se nedokázal zklamat v lidech. Svérázný šedesátník si sice příliš nerozumí se svými dospělými dětmi a jejich rodinami, pro které vylepšil svou chalupu, ale o to víc nezištně pomáhá všem v blízkém i vzdálenějším okolí. Stane se i nečekaně snadnou obětí zkušené podvodnice... V nádherné krkonošské chalupě žije svérázný všeuměl, šedesátiletý Joska Platejz.

programme.title: O lidech před pultem a za ním II. epocha
programme.desc: Další ze satiricko-výchovných filmů Ministerstva vnitřního obchodu, který se tentokráte zaměřuje na nešvary spojené s nákupem v samoobsluhách. Moderátorem je opět Miloš Kopecký, který se představí i v rolích různých typů zákazníků. Větší úlohu zde má i Stella Zázvorková... Československý krátkometrážní film

programme.title: Matka Kráčmerka
programme.desc: Komedie o chudé rodině, která skrz miliónovou výhru v loterii ke štěstí přišla. Šetrná branická zelinářka Barbora Kráčmerová si nekoupila novou šálu, ale v bankovním domě Liška los třídní loterie, na který vyhrála milion. Manželé Kráčmerovi pracují pilně v zelinářské zahradě. Šetří na věno jediné dceři Betynce, která má vážnou známost s medikem Zdeborským. Inspirováni zprávou v novinách, rozhodnou se Kráčmerovi koupit los.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (43)
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (44)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (2)
programme.desc: Grizzy is frustrated: just as he was about to coat a nice big fresh salmon with chocolate spread and snuggle up in front of the TV, he discovers that the pantry is empty! His frustration transforms into rage when he finds the last jar in the clutches of the Lemmings, who are organizing a sort of "beach party" in the sandbox.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (3)
programme.desc: Grizzy's nap is interrupted by an annoying vibrating. He sees the forest ranger's cell phone on the couch. It has various functions, including a game to which he instantly becomes addicted. However the Lemmings, who have already detected the phone's music app, need it in order to transform the garage into a discotheque.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (4)
programme.desc: Freed by the thawing ice, a mysterious giant egg slides up to the front door of the log cabin. The Lemmings watch the hatching of a large baby dinosaur that immediately mistakes them for his "mommies." Grizzy cannot tolerate a new intruder like this in the cabin, but how does one earn the respect of a gang of Lemmings armed with a T-Rex, even it is only a baby?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (5)
programme.desc: In order to seduce the she-bear he's infatuated with, Grizzy decides to take things in hand and slim down with the ranger's bodybuilding equipment. But before starting his exercise routine, he will first have to settle the problem of the Lemmings, who are already using the machines as an amusement park.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (6)
programme.desc: By chance, Grizzy discovers that the ranger's new robot vacuum cleaner also gives very pleasant back massages. But the Lemmings see the new gadget more as a competition bumper car. No one wants to do the housecleaning, but everyone wants the robot vacuum cleaner!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (7)
programme.desc: While searching for the television remote control, Grizzy discovers a gadget that controls various functions in the cabin. Hup! One button and there's light! Hup! Another surveys the house's nooks and crannies. Grizzy will finally be able to rid himself of the Lemmings, without even leaving the couch! But beware of losing control...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (8)
programme.desc: To make sure that the Lemmings don't snatch his chocolate spread while he's taking his nap, Grizzy turns the fridge into a safe - combination lock and all. The Lemmings try in vain to break into the fridge until they see Grizzy open the door while sleepwalking. Unfortunately, Grizzy wakes up at the crucial moment. The Lemmings do everything possible to make him fall back asleep as quick as possible.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (9)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have invented a new popcorn game which consists of throwing popcorn and catching it with their mouths. Grizzy notices that his lovely she-bear seems to be drawn by the scent of the grilled corn and decides to invite her over for a snack, just the two of them. But first, he must quickly recover the popcorn from the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to learn to dance the mambo to please the she-bear he's in love with, for she truly adores this rhythm. He finds a learning kit at the ranger's home which has a dance carpet with footprints that light up in rhythm. The only problem is that Lemmings want the ghetto-blaster to continue their rave party to an entirely different beat.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: After receiving a terrible blow over the head, Grizzy is no longer the same: he thinks he's a rodent! He tries to get the gang to adopt him so that he might participate in their fun and games like any other Lemming. But it's not long before his newfound comrades start to find him rather heavy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (12)
programme.desc: Grizzy is exhausted and the couch has never seemed so enticing! He goes to fetch a pillow and a sleeping mask, but the Lemmings have entirely different plans for the couch. They see it as a fabulous trampoline and the ideal spot for an aerobics session. To win the right to have his nap, the weary bear must first contend with the super-energetic Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (13)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers that the frenzied "break dance" the Lemmings are doing is actually due to the fleas they are infested with. When Grizzy catches them too, it's panic all round! Grizzy is determined to eliminate the parasites, down to the very last one. The problem is his little roommates have no desire whatsoever to be treated...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (14)
programme.desc: Another heat wave: even the riverbed is dried up. One very thirsty Grizzy discovers that the Lemmings have used the last remaining bottles of water to fill their inflatable pool. He has no intention of letting the Lemmings swim in what might very well be his last chance to quench his thirst.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (15)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have caught a little spider. Her sticky, elastic threads are absolutely perfect for bungee jumping. Grizzy, who has no intention of getting caught in the web, decides to crush the insect. The only problem: he discovers that he has arachnophobia, which is seriously going to complicate the task.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (16)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips in a competition to win goodies. Indeed, next to the supermarket are two jackpot-style machines with slots the size of the lids. But more importantly, there's a key to be won that makes you eligible for the grand prize... the giant jar of Yummy on display under a glass cover.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (32)
programme.desc: Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (33)
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (34)
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (35)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Lamput (38)
programme.desc: “Chasing Lamput” turns out to be the ultimate backstage pass; the Docs pursue the orange blob through the dressing room and directly onto the stage of a gigantic stadium rock concert. The crowd goes wild. Which raises questions about their taste in music, to be honest; Skinny plays guitar like he’s gotten himself tangled in the strings (which he has), and Specs’ drumming, well, it’s certainly got passion. No taste, skill or rhythm, but certainly passion.

programme.title: Moley (10)
programme.desc: When Moley helps take care of the worms at Dotty’s Adopt a Worm Rescue Center, the Gardener sends Squirm to pose as a homeless worm and help him steal Manny.

programme.title: Moley (11)
programme.desc: Moley vows to not eat worms for a few days in support of Dotty’s veganism and his worm craving temptations get out of control.

programme.title: Moley (12)
programme.desc: When Moley spends the day with a young mole named Cheese who wants to be just like him, Moley helps Cheese recognize his own talents and uniqueness.

programme.title: Moley (13)
programme.desc: Mishmosh builds a tunnel digger, upsetting some that it will replace moles’ need to dig themselves. Dotty accidently gets locked in the machine and it gets activated!

programme.title: Moley (14)
programme.desc: When Buttercup (the Queen’s dog) digs his way down into Moletown, he forms a bond with the Gardener.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (4)
programme.desc: In this country-inspired music video, Buff the Bat-Truck shows off his strength as he tows the bad guys out of town and lifts the spirits of his fellow Batwheels with his sensitive side, all while protecting the people (and critters) of Gotham.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (25)
programme.desc: Chep discovers he is great at giving snails massages. But the Food and Travel Snails now want massages all the time. Exhausting! Chep has to learn how to tell them NO!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (26)
programme.desc: Mush-Mush goes on an adventure with Morel and Sushi-Mushi. He worries he won’t be cool enough to fit in with the older Mushables, so makes Chep come along for support.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (27)
programme.desc: Lilit loves dancing. The only Mushable she hasn’t danced with is Amanita. But Amanita doesn’t dance. Can Lilit get her dancing?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (28)
programme.desc: Miff has a blast playing a game with our Mushlers - one that Fung refused to play. Now Fung worries that he has lost his best friend and so tries to win her back.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (29)
programme.desc: To prove to everyone that he does not make cooking mistakes, Sushi-Mushi revisits his chef training. But what he really needs training in, is admitting mistakes!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (3)
programme.desc: The Kazoom Kids must choose their hero name as they take on Cerealiak with the help of Mighty Moo.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (46)
programme.desc: Kept awake by Tom watching TV, Jerry goes outside and encounters some lightning bugs. The smallest one can't keep up, so Jerry steals Tom's energy drink for the little guy. It helps, but soon the super-charged bug causes unexpected issues for Tom and Jerry.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (47)
programme.desc: Skullie warns Tom that it's almost midnight, so he'd best be on alert for one of the Catsylvania ghouls to show up. Tom reaches for a towel to wipe the soap out of his eyes but is shocked to discover that he's not using a towel at all, but a Mummy-cat's wrap! Soon, the Mummy-cat finds ways to freak out Tom and befuddle him, Jerry and Tuffy all over the house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (48)
programme.desc: Hoping to woo Toodles, Tom decides to make some homemade perfume for her. He throws in many unusual ingredients and gets a surprisingly pleasant outcome, getting the attention he craved. However, soon Tom and Jerry must come up with a plan when the heavenly scent turns bad.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (49)
programme.desc: When Tom and Butch both arrive to ask out Toodles, their competitive behavior prompts her to send them away to a charm school she recently attended. But how will they fare in the grueling etiquette courses taught by elegant cat instructors?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (50)
programme.desc: Things go awry when Cates orders Tom to clean and inspect the family automobile. Tom, Jerry and Tuffy end up taking the car into the countryside and doing their best to control it. As Tom reads and attempts to follow the instruction manual, Jerry and Tuffy help, but they also suffer many near-misses.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (45)
programme.desc: Grizzy is about to start eating the last remaining food in the cabin: cocktail snacks. But the sly Lemmings get there first. A fight breaks out but is quickly cut short by the unexpected visit of a wart hog. The pig devours the crackers and then, using his snout, detects a forgotten old package of candy under the bed, which he also proceeds to gobble down. Everyone realizes that the creature has the ability to find food.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (46)
programme.desc: In order to win a trophy filled with Yummy candies, Grizzy and the Lemmings take part in a safari photo competition on an animal reserve. They must capture the portraits of a number of wild animals that live in the park. It requires all their cunning to approach the elephant, wart hog and bat and take photos for the contest. But when it comes to the super-speedy, blue-necked ostrich, it's a different kettle of fish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (47)
programme.desc: While Grizzy organizes a picnic alongside the pond, the Lemmings steal his jar of Yummy using water balls to discreetly advance underwater. Despite their equipment, the bear surprises the Lemmings and traps the rodents inside a waterproof ball which he throws far into the distance. An ostrich mistakes the ball for her egg and sits on it, waiting for the egg to hatch. The Lemmings are adopted by this new mother who is prepared to do anything to satisfy her offspring!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (15)
programme.desc: Big Rex, the island's most feared predator, imprints on Miguel after being saved from a rockslide. Convinced he can train the mighty T-Rex to help around HQ, Miguel brings him home! But between broken equipment and a very terrified herd of dinos, it's clear that Big Rex doesn't belong in captivity! And worse, the raptor trio is running wild, wreaking havoc now that their "boss" is gone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (16)
programme.desc: The Ranchers spot a Mosasaurus, the ocean's mightiest predator! Min quickly realizes the mother Mosa has come here to give birth! After the baby is born, the exhausted mama drifts off to sleep. Min gives the newborn its first health check-up, but just as she finishes, the mother wakes! The enraged Mosa charges, triggering a rockslide that separates Min, Blitz, and the baby from the team!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (17)
programme.desc: An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about his lovely summers at scout camp as a boy, and sets him planning a night under the stars with Teddy. Purchasing a tent becomes a tricky problem - but nothing will stop him having a good time, even if he has to get the garden shed over the roof of his house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (18)
programme.desc: When his model aeroplane is blown out of the sky by that of a rival kid, Mr. Bean sets his sights on revenge. Next day, his newly constructed fighter plane, almost ready for take-off, sadly lacks a vital part - and the blinking model shop is shut! No matter. It’s chocks away with Teddy at the controls, fighting for airspace over London N10.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (37)
programme.desc: Baby Moose is dismayed by the recklessness of the Baby Lemmings, who wander through the forest oblivious to the dangers around them. Exhausted by having to save them from small dangers, he decides instead to teach them the rudiments of safety and equip them with protective gear. But the Baby Lemmings aren't too keen on this.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (38)
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover that bouncing on mushrooms makes a bass drum sound. The rhythmic sound makes Baby Lynx want to dance. Seeing her, the baby lemmings discover the joys of dancing and dance with her. But Baby Lynx wants to remain the center of attention and prevents the lemmings from dancing. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings discover a cave with a crystal on the ceiling that turns into a sort of disco ball, creating a real dance hall where they'd rather Baby Lynx didn't come.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (4)
programme.desc: The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back!

programme.title: Batwheels (16)
programme.desc: On Halloween Night, Poison Ivy brings all the pumpkins to life, creating an army of Snack-O-Lanterns that are eating all the candy. It’s up to Redbird and Bam to end her pumpkin panic to save Gotham’s Halloween fun, as well as their own.

programme.title: Batwheels (16)
programme.desc: When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (19)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin. It’s a contest to find out who can hold their nerve the longest. Does Mr Bean win? Is his car left unscathed? And more importantly do we find out who the driver of the Reliant Robin really is?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)
programme.desc: Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (32)
programme.desc: Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (52)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is over the moon when he meets Mr. Pod because both men have so much in common; same shirt, jacket, trousers and underpants. And to top it all, Pod is Bean’s spitting image! Bean falls to Earth with a bump, though, when his girlfriend, Irma Gobb, finds Mr. Pod much better looking than him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (33)
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (34)
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (21)
programme.desc: Scooby runs into an old kennel mate Axel who is a highly trained Police dog who thinks mystery of the Junk yard monster is too big a case for the gang.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (22)
programme.desc: When a video game company tries to buy an old algorithm from Velma and convince her to work for them in San Francisco, the gang becomes embroiled in the mystery of a video game villain who has seemingly come to life, the Ghost Chef.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (6)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a hand-shaped scepter ornated with a gold nugget that covers anything it touches with gold. Grizzy uses the object to “gold leaf” the Lemmings and swipe their chocolate bar. The Lemmings use their golden casts as armors to recover their chocolate. During the combat, the gold nugget is replaced by a chocolate one: the scepter now coats everything with chocolate. The Lemmings snatch it and flee.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (7)
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize a dance contest where the first prize is a jar of chocolate spread. Grizzy is hungry and decides to participate. He partners up with a talented dancing parrot and wins. Incapable of sharing, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the prize. The parrot brings the jar to a temple devoted to the glory of dancing parrots. To get it back, Grizzy and the Lemmings must perform a choreography. They decide to rehearse together.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (8)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange creature fossilized in amber resin that resembles him. A natural science encyclopedia confirms that it’s his ancestor. Grizzy wants to take the block of amber, but the Lemmings fight him for it because the blue animal with big teeth is their ancestor too. The block cracks during their fight and frees the ancestor who turns out to be a rather unmanageable burden.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (9)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a strange card game representing the elements along with instructions. The idea is to pretend that the ground is on fire or of ice, like in the game “Floor is Lava.” They transform the cabin into a giant adventure trail. Depending on the card drawn, they must avoid zones on the floor with flames or wax. Grizzy unceremoniously gets rids of the setup to regain control of the cabin. One of the cards lands on a stone slab that transforms into lava.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a very particular cocoa tree with chocolate-spread sap! Reduced to eating canned Brussels sprouts, the only remaining food in the cabin, Grizzy is baffled when he sees the Lemmings parading past to equip themselves with all sorts of containers: ladles, soup spoons, bowls, buckets, basins, etc. He watches them through binoculars and discovers that they have planted a faucet in a tree where chocolate spread flows. Grizzy decides to siphon off their tree.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: Grizzy expels the Lemmings from the cabin where they had built a cumbersome obstacle course. Peaceful at last and feeling lazy, he is determined not to leave his couch. The Lemmings discover a magic Mayan disc that allows you to choose instantaneous mutations of other animals’ features: bat wings, reindeer antlers, elephant trunks, etc. The mutant Lemmings return to the cabin, determined to continue playing their game while enjoying their new accessories.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (40)
programme.desc: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (18)
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (19)
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy - the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night - but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (24)
programme.desc: Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell - and embarks on a hilarious mission to pull out this menace. Bean’s DIY attempts fail to succeed, and he is left with no other choice but to visit the dreaded dentist. But can Bean brave the Dentist’s chair? Or will the dentist despair when faced with Bean’s antics?

programme.title: Lamput (30)
programme.desc: Lamput faints of thirst on a desert highway, so already it’s not a great day for the little orange shape-shifter. Add to that the fact that Specs and Skinny just happen by in a lockup van, and things go south pretty promptly. Specs and Skinny learn a valuable lesson: maybe if you’re going to anger a morphing super-blob by throwing them in the back of a van and withholding precious water, you shouldn’t do it whilst driving by a 100 foot cliff drop down to the open ocean.

programme.title: Batwheels (9)
programme.desc: When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover!

programme.title: Batwheels (16)
programme.desc: When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (24)
programme.desc: Bam gushes over his personal hero and idol - Batman! During an ongoing mission, Bam awes at all the cool moves and awesome antics that Batman shows off. Potentially can be done with existing footage.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (18)
programme.desc: The gang hits the ski slopes, although Daphne's more focused on nailing Fred with a revenge snowball. Their snowy fun is soon interrupted by the appearance of an evil Snowman Monster eager to scare all trespassers off his mountain.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (19)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve and Fred is ready to solve a Christmas mystery! Unfortunately, the gang has arrived in a town that's being attacked by a Pterodactyl and it doesn't seem to have anything to do with Christmas!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (22)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers in shock that the TV has been replaced with a trompe-l’oeil image. Furious, he flushes the Lemmings out of their hiding place where they’d hoped to watch their favorite cartoon in peace and propels them as far as possible. They land in an ancient cave where a powerful spirit capable of entering individuals is asleep. The Lemmings decide to free the spirit and send it to Grizzy. But will they be able to control the spirit?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (23)
programme.desc: Not easy to enjoy a DVD about salmon when the Lemmings are having a disco party right there. Grizzy sends them packing with such force that they land at the research station, where they discover a state-of-the-art U.V. cabin. When turned up to the max, the light therapy and music options can advantageously replace the disco equipment Grizzy destroyed. The noise they make causes a block of ice to break off. It hurdles down the slope to the cabin and destroys Grizzy’s TV.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (24)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun destroying ice towers. When Grizzy sees them, it inspires him to sculpt statues of himself. The Lemmings cannot resist the temptation to destroy the statues of Grizzy, who does everything in his power to protect them.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (40)
programme.desc: The Lemmings are all lined up on the couch to watch a cartoon film where a mouse plays nasty tricks on a cat. Grizzy, who has decided to take his nap, switches off the TV and confiscates the batteries of the remote control to make sure they can't switch their program back on. But is it wise to frustrate a gang of Lemmings who've been inspired by a gag-filled cartoon?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (41)
programme.desc: Once again, Grizzy shows the Lemmings that they just don't measure up to him physically and that the last jar of chocolate spread is for the strongest. The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (42)
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Lamput (32)
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side?

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (17)
programme.desc: The Ranchers glide through the kelp forest, gathering fresh sea greens! Above them, the Tinhorns float in their family air balloon, tossing trash overboard and polluting the ocean! Peace turns to panic when Thunderfin, the island's massive Mosasaur, surges toward the Jetter! The Ranchers race to escape as the creature slams into the sub, but his movements aren't just angry, they're pained!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (18)
programme.desc: The Ranchers are trying to wrangle a stubborn triceratops with a log jammed on her horn! Watching from the sidelines, Clara Tinhorn finds herself strangely charmed by the feisty creature, while Atticus has his eye on something shinier: the Ranchers' Jungle Jetter! Later that night, under cover of darkness; Clara, Atticus and their new dino friend sneak into the HQ with plans to snag the vehicle.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (12)
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (13)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (14)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to find a nice quiet place to read his book so he sets off for the Library. But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (27)
programme.desc: Envious of all the attention his landlady is receiving because of a broken leg, Mr. Bean decides to 'break' his leg too. When he ends up in hospital under the care of the Matron from Hell he discovers there are some kinds of attention even he doesn't enjoy.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (24)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings become friends and play with crickets. Baby Moose hates these bugs, which terrify him. Baby Moose hides to avoid running into the insects, but he comes face to face with a cricket that has been thrown off while playing with the lemmings. Panic-stricken, Baby Moose tries to put these threatening pests out of action, but after a blunder he finds himself adrift on the water with a cricket!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (25)
programme.desc: It's been raining a lot these last few days! That's why the Baby Lemmings are discovering little croaking frogs! They're so much fun! Baby Chipmunk is having great difficulty climbing trees made slippery by the rain to reach her nuts. Seeing the frogs' long tongues, she decides to “borrow” them to make her job easier.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (15)
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover a fun new game: running on logs! While playing, the Baby lemmings find themselves racing Baby Lynx without realizing it. To the horror of Baby Lynx, who hates defeat, she loses the race! The Baby Lemmings with their logs are faster than Baby Lynx. Her pride stung, she decides to steal the vehicle that allows her to be faster.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (43)
programme.desc: Bugs wants to be the first to ride a new mega roller coaster and finds himself lucky to be front and center with Porky Pig.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (43)
programme.desc: Bugs attempts to help Dr. Clovenhoof become the Superhero he's always dreamed of becoming.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (44)
programme.desc: Bugs and Yosemite Sam fight over the last hot toy of the holiday season.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (44)
programme.desc: When Squeaks mistakes the Barbarian for Santa Claus Bugs has to intervene in order to retrieve his Holiday Wish List.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (25)
programme.desc: The gang goes on a camping trip, although they can't really agree on why. Fred's desire for the gang to get in touch with their natural instincts and hones their mystery skills, turns into on-the-job training as Viking Ghosts attack and attempt to drive them away - or worse.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (26)
programme.desc: Fred is on trial, convicted of being the real mastermind behind all the mysteries he's solved. With the help of his defense attorney, Daphne, we go back over the day's events at a town that had been abandoned since the 1950's because of a toxic chemical spill where a Toxic Mutant has been terrorizing all who dare go near the town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)
programme.desc: When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride? Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (7)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is furious with the untidy state of the streets and all the people who drop litter so he goes on a one-man mission to clean up the town. Armed with several bin bags Mr Bean collects all the rubbish and puts up his own ‘No Littering’ signs - which have absolutely no effect. When the police show no interest in his campaign Bean builds a homemade vacuuming contraption causing chaos and mayhem wherever he goes.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (65)
programme.desc: Tom is chasing the mice around the haunted house when midnight strikes, and he finds himself face-to-face with a green-faced beast who's just as surprised to encounter Tom. It's soon revealed to be Toodles, who's a good witch brewing magic beauty products. Although Tom is enchanted at first, things stop going smoothly when he helps with her potions.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (66)
programme.desc: After entering Tyke in an agility contest, Spike sets up a course for the puppy in the backyard. Soon, Spike decides the course isn't hard enough and gets Tom to help, bending Tom into pretzel-like positions for Tyke to leap over, through, or into. After all this preparation, Tyke must still make it to the competition on time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (67)
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry take a case from a mother tortoise to find out where her son Seymour is sneaking off to at night. They discover Seymour is self-training to win a championship boxing match, planning to pay off bills with the prize money so his mom can quit the car wash. programme.title: Příběhy kocoura Modroočka (3)
programme.desc: Modroočko má jemný kožíšek, velikánské modré oči, dlouhé vlasy a hebký čumáček. Je to vzdělaný kocourek, který si píše deník a bydlí u svého pána, spisovatele. Objevuje svět kolem sebe a vypráví o všech svých dvounohých a čtyřnohých přátelích. Z díry v plotu ho zachrání nový přítel - kocour Bělovous, na dovolené získá další přátele - ježka Šramotu, loveckého psa Fouska a králíka Bílé Pírko. Také se seznámí s kočičkou Kiki a popere se kvůli ní s obrovským zlomyslným kocourem Žluťákem.

programme.title: Broučci (4)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (1)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: Tisíc a jedna noc (5)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál, jehož jednotlivé části vyprávějí příhody ze známé knihy Pohádky tisíce a jedné noci. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Ztratila se Bílá paní
programme.desc: Z hradní síně se ztratil originál obrazu Bílé paní. Parta vesnických kluků se rozhodne vypátrat pravého pachatele krádeže. Získanou odměnu věnují invalidnímu kamarádovi... Československý rodinný film

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Přátelé bermudského trojúhelníku
programme.desc: Tři povídky o tom, jak mizí lidé a věci. Trojici humorných sci-fi povídek debutujících režisérů sjednocuje myšlenka, že bermudský trojúhelník s tajemnými úkazy se začal přesouvat a lze jej vystopovat kdekoli na světě, včetně českého a slovenského území. I tady totiž dochází k nevysvětlitelným přesunům v prostoru a čase. Na VIII. světovém kongresu Přátel bermudského trojúhelníku vystoupí docent Kadeřábek s novou hypotézou: trojúhelník s výskytem záhadných úkazů se stěhuje.

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Ves v pohraničí
programme.desc: Příběh o osidlování českého pohraničí v roce 1945. Rodina pražského zelináře Pavlase byla mezi prvními přistěhovalci, kteří osídlili pohraniční obec Severov. Novým obyvatelům se společně podaří včas a s úspěchem sklidit první úrodu - bude však nutné odhalit německého diverzanta, který se vydává za správce pily... Československé drama

programme.title: Zlepšovák
programme.desc: Dělník Novák předkládá referentovi pro vynálezy Rejskovi svůj návrh na novou a všestranně využitelnou vysokofrekvenční brzdu. Složka s dokumentací vynálezu prochází celým podnikem, ale zodpovědní pracovníci se chovají odmítavě... Krátká satira Petra Schulhoffa. Československý krátkometrážní film

programme.title: Akce v Istanbulu
programme.desc: Podaří se mu přimět významného vědce k návratu do vlasti? Komunistický agent, který se zdárně uchytil u amerických tajných služeb, to nemá snadné, hrozí mu odhalení, ale přesto zachraňuje českého vědce, kterého chtěli imperialisté unést. Film měl být psychologickým portrétem rozvědčíka, vystaveného silným stresům, ale přesto přesvědčeného o své pravdě. Zůstala nezamýšlená parodie s mnoha dobrými herci, kteří se ve filmu uvolili účinkovat. Československé kriminální drama

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. programme.title: Tankový prapor
programme.desc: O službě vlasti a strastech i láskách rotného Dannyho Smiřického v naší armádě na počátku 50. let. Historky z vojenské služby za časů generála Čepičky podle slavné knihy Josefa Škvoreckého. Čerstvý doktor filozofie Daniel „Danny“ Smiřický je v rámci povinné vojenské služby přidělen k tankovému praporu ve vojenském prostoru Kobylec. Jako velitel tanku T-34/85 prodělává cvičení, jako kulturní pracovník je přítomen plnění Fučíkova odznaku a zažívá další příhody z vojenského prostředí 50. let.

programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: Noční motýl
programme.desc: Romantický příběh dívky, kterou nešťastná láska přivedla na scestí Posádkové městečko na konci 19. století. Vychovatelka Marta přijde o místo, protože její zaměstnavatelka žárlí na pozornost, kterou krásné dívce věnují místní důstojníci. Lehkomyslný poručík Kala se netají tím, že Martu svedl, a ta je maloměstskou pokryteckou společností morálně odsouzena. Živí se jako zpěvačka v nočním podniku pochybné pověsti. Při natáčení byla věnována mimořádná péče nákladným kostýmům a výpravě.

programme.title: Manželské etudy
programme.desc: Vědecká studie různých druhů a poddruhů mužů a žen, která zkoumá i soužití jednotlivých poddruhů ve společné domácnosti. Vtipná a trefná animovaná groteska. Československý animovaný film

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. programme.title: 5 milionů svědků
programme.desc: Dvojice kriminalistů Suda a Koval vyšetřují případ z televizního studia. Herec Faltys umírá v přímém přenosu televizní inscenace. Zda jde o náhodu, nebo promyšlenou vraždu ukáže až rekonstrukce v televizním studiu. Nyní spatříme naivní připomínku toho, že televize kdysi vysílala i inscenace živě, avšak v tomto případě získal přímý přenos překvapivě kriminální rozměr. Během vysílání byl totiž zabit jeden z herců - a vidělo to všech oněch pět milionů lidí, kteří televizi sledovali.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (17)

Grizzy rapidly discovers that the true "interference" is the Lemmings, who are using the TV antenna as a diving board for their water games.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (18)
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a rave party. When Grizzy throws their ghetto blaster into the river, he sparks a general power outage. Unless he finds an alternative source of energy, and before the Lemmings do, he can kiss his TV night goodbye!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (19)
programme.desc: When he realizes that his beloved she-bear adores the smell of flowers, Grizzy decides to offer her the geraniums that decorate the window ledges of the ranger's cabin. Can he bring them to her without the Lemmings, who are skating out by the caribou dung pit and trash bins, ruining his desired effect?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (20)
programme.desc: Decidedly, this is not Grizzy's day: after making a fool of himself in front of the she-bear he's in love with, he is ousted from the log cabin by the Lemmings, who are in top form. Grizzy lands in a field of clover where he notices that one of them - which has four leaves - seems to bring him good luck. Could his chance be changing?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (21)
programme.desc: Grizzy can¿t believe his eyes when he sees objects moving all by themselves. When he realizes it¿s the Lemmings who are playing around with a particularly powerful magnet, he has a stroke of genius. He will design a telekinesis trick to impress his beloved she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (22)
programme.desc: Further to a misunderstanding, Grizzy is persuaded that the she-bear he's in love with has been turned into a frog. Whilst he looks through the ranger's books of fairytales, searching for a means to return his beloved to her original form, the Lemmings try to recover the frog, with whom they have so much fun playing rodeo games.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (23)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature. When the Lemmings drag the baby into their dangerous games, the overprotective Grizzy steps in, provoking even more perilous situations!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (24)
programme.desc: By pure chance, Grizzy discovers the pleasures of video games on the ranger's console. The Lemmings want to try their hand at the joystick but Grizzy refuses to interrupt his Kart racing game. They try everything, including temptation, to get him away from the console but there's nothing doing, Grizzy is addicted.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (25)
programme.desc: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away while he prepares a popcorn party for his beloved she-bear. But his double¿s artificial intelligence truly leaves to be desired. If only it were as clever as the original...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (26)
programme.desc: When she is accidentally hit over the head, the she-bear Grizzy¿s in love thinks she¿s a Lemming. Grizzy thinks that another little well-placed bang over the head will knock her ideas back into place. The only problem is that the Lemmings, who are delighted to have a new playmate, have no intention of letting him proceed with his plan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (27)
programme.desc: When a meteorite falls not far from the log cabin, strange berries start to grow. One of their properties is that they make anyone who eats them grow to disproportionate sizes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (28)
programme.desc: Under the wood floor of the log cabin, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the entrance to an underground gallery with an old treasure card that indicates the location of a treasure. Upon closer look, the representation of this treasure greatly resembles a giant jar of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (29)
programme.desc: When he brandishes a native american scepter that the Lemmings brought home with other antique objects, Grizzy sees the Lemmings bow low before him and behave like servants. One of them has escaped the spell, but he will have to confront both Grizzy and his fellow creatures in order to recover the scepter and reverse the spell.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (30)
programme.desc: Grizzy tries to impress the she-bear that he's in love with by making a sculpture of her from a piece of wood. But as soon as the artist's back is turned, the Lemmings gnaw at the work of art in order to transform it into a toboggan slide. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (31)

From that point on, Grizzy has only one objective: stop the din, which is not at all helping his migraine headache. But for the Lemmings, the party must go on at any price.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (36)
programme.desc: Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (37)
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed - but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front - but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (38)
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (39)

Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

The blue nerds get ejected hard by venue security, and Lamput becomes the hit look of the show. So versatile! So changeable! One size fits all!

programme.title: Moley (15)
programme.desc: Moley agrees to organize a town talent show, but when the level of actual “talent” in Mole Town is lacking, he worries the show will be a failure.

programme.desc: Moley and his mom enter Mishmosh’s yearly science fair while the Gardener and Squirm plot to snag Manny.

programme.title: Moley (18)

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (32)

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (33)
programme.desc: Lilit loves Chanterelle’s art so much. But when Chanterelle makes a statue of Lilit, she can’t stand it. Does Lilit tell the truth or does she just carry on pretending to like it?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (34)

programme.title: Batwheels (13)

The Ranchers race to escape as the creature slams into the sub, but his movements aren't just angry, they're pained!

Later that night, under cover of darkness; Clara, Atticus and their new dino friend sneak into the HQ with plans to snag the vehicle.

Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving - but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure - a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (25)

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (9)

programme.title: Batwheels (10)

programme.title: Batwheels (17)
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.desc: The Batcave's cutest resident bat Alfie sneaks into Bam the Batmobile and causes adorable chaos during a mission to stop the Ducky Boat down at Gotham Docks.

One of the penguins, who did not get his reward in fish, is disgruntled. Grizzy has him taste the Yummy, then throws the jar far away to get rid of the penguin.

The Lemmings bring him to Grizzy, never dreaming that the giant will immediately fall in love with the Ranger’s cabin and throw a very original party.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (27)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are bored. A coconut rolls over to Grizzy’s feet, pulling the bear out of his state of torpor. He imagines a sort of face on the nut and decides to care for it, like a child with its doll. He has so much fun playing with his new toy that the Lemmings want to join in. But when the bear refuses, the Lemmings ruse: they hide inside other coconuts in hopes of being adopted by Grizzy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (43)
programme.desc: Grizzy is persuaded that he's discovered the ultimate gadget for good living: a pair of connected glasses for watching TV in panoramic view, with all sorts of indicators, namely an intrusion warning signal. There is only one real drawback: the speedometer function which the Lemmings adore.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (44)
programme.desc: The Lemmings clamor for their turn to play with the ranger's mobile phone, but Grizzy isn't in the sharing mood. And he's very talented at flattening anything that comes near, without looking up from his game. The Lemmings invent an implacable protection system which should enable them to recover the mobile in complete safety.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (45)

It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (19)

He names her Noodles, and she's eager to help, maybe a little too eager!

When she discovers the Baby Lemmings' game of popping as many bubbles as possible, she decides to put an end to it.

Faced with this rampage, Baby Raccoon decides to block the baby lemmings and resume his housework, but the little baby lemmings have more than one trick up their sleeve!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (45)
programme.desc: Bugs' slumber is interrupted when his ears decide it's time to go dancing.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (45)
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks square off as street musicians.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (46)
programme.desc: Bugs is tricked into Elmer Fudd's new Petting Zoo but Bugs is quick to make his escape.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (46)

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (1)
